passages.title: An Unforgettable Evening at Riverside Bistro
passages.titleVi: Một buổi tối đáng nhớ tại quán ăn ven sông
passages.text: Last Friday evening, my family gathered for a special dinner at a charming riverside restaurant. Before arriving, my sister and I stopped at a small neighborhood cafe to have afternoon tea and chat about our week. When we stepped into the dining room of the bistro, soft acoustic music and warm golden lighting created a cozy atmosphere. A friendly waiter greeted us politely at the entrance and escorted us to a quiet corner table overlooking the river. A few minutes later, our attentive waitress handed us the dinner menus and recommended the chef's specialty dish of the evening. To begin our meal, we ordered a crisp garden salad tossed with creamy balsamic dressing and crunchy croutons. My father preferred a thin-crust Italian pizza topped with fresh herbs, mushrooms, and melted cheese, while my mother chose a freshly cooked salmon fillet served with steamed broccoli. When the food arrived, everything smelled wonderful and tasted absolutely delicious. We ate our dinner leisurely while sharing funny childhood memories and laughing together. The staff checked on our table regularly to refill water glasses and ensure that every guest felt welcome. After finishing our dinner, we thanked both the waiter and the waitress for their outstanding hospitality. Dining together in such a peaceful setting reminded us of how important family moments truly are. As we walked out along the illuminated riverbank, the pleasant evening breeze provided a perfect ending to our wonderful dinner gathering.

passages.text: Dining out at a distinguished culinary establishment offers an exquisite journey into creative cooking and hospitality. Last Saturday, our family celebrated an anniversary by reserving a cozy corner table at The Grand Bistro downtown. As we sat down, our courteous waiter presented the dinner menu, highlighting seasonal chef specialties alongside traditional continental fare. Before the main dishes arrived, the kitchen team began to mix fresh herbs into savory garlic butter, while an apprentice perfected the salad by mixing delicate organic greens with balsamic vinaigrette. The chef also offered an artisanal seafood appetizer featuring thinly sliced raw sea bass seasoned with crushed pink peppercorns and extra virgin olive oil. When the main courses arrived, the enticing aromas delighted our senses. My father ordered tender roasted chicken seasoned with fragrant herbs, while my brother chose a mildly spicy coconut curry served alongside aromatic basmati rice. Each dish delivered an extraordinary depth of balanced flavor, proving that patient preparation elevates simple ingredients into culinary masterpieces. In the bustling open kitchen, experienced line cooks monitored each hot skillet diligently to ensure that delicate crusts were never burnt. Beside them, another cook tossed golden fried potatoes with rosemary until they achieved a crisp exterior and fluffy center. Attentive servers moved gracefully across the dining room to serve hot dishes promptly and replenish sparkling water glasses. When our meal concluded, we left a generous cash tip on the table to express our heartfelt appreciation for the outstanding service and warm atmosphere. Walking out into the pleasant evening air, we agreed that sharing a memorable feast nourishes both body and spirit.

passages.titleVi: Lớp học nghệ thuật ẩm thực cuối tuần của bếp trưởng
passages.text: Every Saturday, our municipal culinary academy hosts a popular community workshop where aspiring food lovers learn essential culinary arts. The head chef begins the morning lesson by demonstrating how different cooking methods highlight natural flavors in everyday eats. To initiate the multi-course meal, apprentices prepare an appetizing starter featuring crisp sourdough bruschetta and creamy garlic spread. Next, the chef explains the importance of precise heat control when preparing vegetables. Students gently boil tender young potatoes in sea-salted water until soft, while a junior instructor plates delicate boiled carrots sprinkled with fresh chopped herbs. Across the kitchen line, students learn how to fry crunchy golden fritters in heated olive oil, testing the temperature carefully so the batter never absorbs excess grease. Nearby, roasting stations fill the room with mouthwatering aromas as cooks roast whole herb-rubbed chickens alongside sliced root vegetables in a convection oven. The chef emphasizes that patient baking transforms raw dough into culinary gold, teaching students the art of artisanal bread making. Everyone watches in awe as golden brown baked baguettes emerge from the stone deck oven with a hollow crackling crust. He also demonstrates how to bake flaky fruit tartlets until the caramelized sugar bubbles gently. To complete the banquet, the pastry team presents an exquisite dessert consisting of warm chocolate lava cake topped with cool vanilla bean ice cream. Satisfied participants sit down together around a communal dining table, celebrating their teamwork and tasting every handmade creation. Mastering diverse cooking techniques enriches domestic hospitality and turns daily meals into joyous celebrations.

passages.title: A Delightful Community Food Fair and Evening Feast
passages.titleVi: Hội chợ ẩm thực cộng đồng thú vị và bữa tiệc tối
passages.text: Every autumn, our university campus hosts a vibrant community food festival celebrating diverse cultural traditions and international cuisine. Students, faculty members, and local neighbors eagerly gather to explore an exciting variety of dining options. In the afternoon, energetic crowds packed inside the spacious campus cafeteria to sample delicious specialty dishes prepared by enthusiastic student clubs. One popular corner station proudly displayed fresh organic platters for each visiting vegan guest, featuring spiced lentil patties and roasted garden vegetables. Across the sunny lawn, an outdoor smokehouse pit filled the crisp autumn breeze with savory aromas from slow-cooked hickory barbecue. Hungry attendees queued patiently beside the bustling open grill to order juicy grilled skewers, sweet caramelized corn cobs, and warm flatbreads. A coastal seafood vendor served generous platters of freshly caught ocean seafood paired with chilled citrus water and tangy garlic dipping sauce. Beside the lively grill station, happy children smiled brightly as friendly cooks handed them baskets of golden, crispy French fries sprinkled with crushed sea salt. Nearby, a boutique food stall showcased delicate smoked salmon canapes layered carefully on crunchy rye sourdough toast. For dessert, talented local bakers presented flaky puff pastries topped with sweet blackberry glaze and fluffy vanilla whipped cream. Guests were equally delighted by generous slices of warm homemade apple crumble pie infused with aromatic cinnamon and nutmeg. As dusk gently settled over the grounds, neighborhood families and friends gathered together around long wooden picnic tables for a restful communal supper. Sharing wholesome food and cheerful conversation under string lights strengthened bonds and celebrated community unity. Everyone returned home feeling refreshed and deeply thankful for an unforgettable festival filled with exceptional flavor and genuine warmth.

sentencePairs.en: Every autumn, our university campus hosts a vibrant community food festival celebrating diverse cultural traditions and international cuisine.
sentencePairs.vi: Mỗi độ thu về, khuôn viên trường đại học của chúng tôi lại tổ chức một lễ hội ẩm thực cộng đồng sôi động tôn vinh các truyền thống văn hóa đa dạng và nền ẩm thực quốc tế.

sentencePairs.en: Students, faculty members, and local neighbors eagerly gather to explore an exciting variety of dining options.
sentencePairs.vi: Sinh viên, các giảng viên và những người hàng xóm địa phương đều hào hứng tụ họp để khám phá nhiều lựa chọn ăn uống phong phú và thú vị.

sentencePairs.en: In the afternoon, energetic crowds packed inside the spacious campus cafeteria to sample delicious specialty dishes prepared by enthusiastic student clubs.
sentencePairs.vi: Vào buổi chiều, những đám đông tràn đầy năng lượng tập trung đông đúc bên trong nhà ăn tự phục vụ rộng rãi của trường để thưởng thức các món ăn đặc sản ngon miệng do các câu lạc bộ sinh viên nhiệt huyết chế biến.

sentencePairs.en: One popular corner station proudly displayed fresh organic platters for each visiting vegan guest, featuring spiced lentil patties and roasted garden vegetables.
sentencePairs.vi: Một quầy góc nổi tiếng tự hào giới thiệu những đĩa đồ ăn hữu cơ tươi ngon cho mỗi thực khách thuần chay đến thăm, gồm chả đậu lăng tẩm gia vị và rau củ vườn nướng.

sentencePairs.en: Across the sunny lawn, an outdoor smokehouse pit filled the crisp autumn breeze with savory aromas from slow-cooked hickory barbecue.
sentencePairs.vi: Bên kia bãi cỏ ngập nắng, một lò nướng hun khói ngoài trời làm ngập tràn làn gió thu trong lành bằng những làn hương thơm quyến rũ từ món thịt nướng gỗ hồ đào nấu chậm.

sentencePairs.en: Hungry attendees queued patiently beside the bustling open grill to order juicy grilled skewers, sweet caramelized corn cobs, and warm flatbreads.
sentencePairs.vi: Những người tham gia đang đói bụng kiên nhẫn xếp hàng cạnh bếp nướng mở nhộn nhịp để gọi những xiên thịt nướng mọng nước, bắp ngô nướng caramen ngọt ngào và bánh mì dẹt ấm nóng.

sentencePairs.en: A coastal seafood vendor served generous platters of freshly caught ocean seafood paired with chilled citrus water and tangy garlic dipping sauce.
sentencePairs.vi: Một người bán hải sản vùng duyên hải đã phục vụ những đĩa hải sản biển mới đánh bắt đầy đặn kết hợp cùng nước cam chanh mát lạnh và sốt chấm tỏi thơm nồng.

sentencePairs.en: Beside the lively grill station, happy children smiled brightly as friendly cooks handed them baskets of golden, crispy French fries sprinkled with crushed sea salt.
sentencePairs.vi: Bên cạnh trạm nướng sôi động, những đứa trẻ vui vẻ mỉm cười rạng rỡ khi các đầu bếp thân thiện trao cho các em những giỏ khoai tây chiên vàng giòn rụm rắc muối biển nghiền.

sentencePairs.en: Nearby, a boutique food stall showcased delicate smoked salmon canapes layered carefully on crunchy rye sourdough toast.
sentencePairs.vi: Gần đó, một quầy đồ ăn nhỏ trưng bày các món canape cá hồi hun khói tinh tế được xếp lớp cẩn thận trên bánh mì nướng men chua lúa mạch đen giòn.

sentencePairs.en: For dessert, talented local bakers presented flaky puff pastries topped with sweet blackberry glaze and fluffy vanilla whipped cream.
sentencePairs.vi: Đối với món tráng miệng, các thợ làm bánh tài ba địa phương đã giới thiệu những chiếc bánh ngàn lớp xốp giòn được phủ lớp sốt dâu đen ngọt ngào và kem tươi đánh bông vani mềm mịn.

sentencePairs.en: Guests were equally delighted by generous slices of warm homemade apple crumble pie infused with aromatic cinnamon and nutmeg.
sentencePairs.vi: Các vị khách cũng thích thú không kém trước những lát bánh táo nướng tự làm thơm nóng ngập hương quế và nhục đậu khấu.

sentencePairs.en: As dusk gently settled over the grounds, neighborhood families and friends gathered together around long wooden picnic tables for a restful communal supper.
sentencePairs.vi: Khi hoàng hôn nhẹ nhàng buông xuống khuôn viên, các gia đình và bạn bè trong khu phố đã cùng nhau quây quần quanh những chiếc bàn dã ngoại bằng gỗ dài cho một bữa ăn tối ấm áp và thư thái.

sentencePairs.en: Sharing wholesome food and cheerful conversation under string lights strengthened bonds and celebrated community unity.
sentencePairs.vi: Chia sẻ đồ ăn lành mạnh và những cuộc trò chuyện vui vẻ dưới ánh đèn dây đã thắt chặt tình thân ái và tôn vinh tinh thần đoàn kết cộng đồng.

sentencePairs.en: Everyone returned home feeling refreshed and deeply thankful for an unforgettable festival filled with exceptional flavor and genuine warmth.
sentencePairs.vi: Mọi người trở về nhà với cảm giác khoan khoái và lòng biết ơn sâu sắc về một lễ hội khó quên ngập tràn hương vị đặc biệt và sự ấm áp chân thành.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'cuisine' phát âm theo chuẩn Mỹ là /kwɪˈziːn/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai với âm /z/ và nguyên âm dài /iː/.
Từ 'cafeteria' có trọng âm chính ở âm tiết thứ ba: /ˌkæf.əˈtɪr.i.ə/, với nguyên âm /ɪr/ rõ ràng.
Từ 'barbecue' phát âm là /ˈbɑːr.bə.kjuː/, trọng âm chính nhấn ở âm tiết đầu tiên với âm /bɑːr/ uốn lưỡi.
Từ 'homemade' là từ ghép có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai: /ˌhoʊmˈmeɪd/, kết thúc bằng âm bật /d/.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where did visitors go to find fresh plant-based dishes during the community food festival?
options: A corner station offering fresh organic platters for visiting vegan guests
An underground meat warehouse storing canned beef
A fast food commercial franchise at the petrol station
A pharmacy counter selling synthetic protein pills
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc nêu rõ: 'One popular corner station proudly displayed fresh organic platters for each visiting vegan guest, featuring spiced lentil patties and roasted garden vegetables.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What dessert did talented local bakers prepare that was topped with sweet blackberry glaze?
options: Flaky puff pastries topped with sweet blackberry glaze and fluffy vanilla whipped cream
Hard frozen breadcrumbs with black pepper
Boiled onion pancakes with soy sauce
Salted butter rolls without any toppings
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn viết: 'talented local bakers presented flaky puff pastries topped with sweet blackberry glaze and fluffy vanilla whipped cream.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why did neighborhood families gather around long wooden picnic tables as dusk settled?
options: To share a restful communal supper and enjoy cheerful conversation under string lights
To conduct a formal scientific experiment on food preservation
To pack unsold plastic furniture into storage trucks
To complain about festival entry fees and loud music
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Trong bài viết: 'neighborhood families and friends gathered together around long wooden picnic tables for a restful communal supper. Sharing wholesome food and cheerful conversation under string lights strengthened bonds'.
